A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MBSR program is effective in improving well being and reducing symptoms in a wide range of individuals.
the practice of meditation exercises is related to increases in mindfulness which are associated with improvements in psychological functioning and well being.
mindfulness meditation leads to increased levels of mindfulness, which in turns leads to improvements in psychological well being.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the practice of meditation is a key factor in determining the extent to which people benefit from MBSR.

the practice of formal meditation techniques, particularly body scan and sitting meditation, is associated with increases in mindfulness, and these increases in mindfulness are related to decreases in symptoms and increases in well being in a clinical population.

the practice of formal mindfulness meditation exercises, in the context of a mindfulness based stress management program, is associated with significant reductions in symptoms and increases in well being, and that these effects appear to be mediated by increases in mindfulness.
